purpose: Re-fetch list so the Windows PC can re-download, into D:/k10-data/, every public source file that exists only on the Mac's damaged /Volumes/Drive (and the Mac scratchpad). Only sources already downloaded before (Kevin: 'PC re-fetches it'); nothing new.

fetch_rules: Verify size then sha256 of each file; for ept_nodes/static_file groups a mismatch means the publisher changed it: stop and report, do not overwrite silently.
Planetary Computer crops and ImageServer exports: if the sha differs, compare dims/corners and report; they are inputs to measurements, not byte-for-byte products.
Throttle (USGS rockyweb returned HTTP 429 once); retry with back-off.
Do not fetch anything not listed.

params.tiling: w_px=round((E-W)*mpd_lon(midlat)/mpp), h_px=round((N-S)*mpd_lat(midlat)/mpp); request tiles <=1024 px a side, each tile's lon/lat box = linear share of the box; paste into a canvas; save PNG. mpd(lat): m_lat=111132.954-559.822cos2phi+1.175cos4phi; m_lon=111412.84cos(phi)-93.5cos3phi+0.118cos5phi
